ukm:Metadata.dc:title: Local Government Byelaws (Wales) Act 2012
ukm:Metadata.dc:description: An Act of the National Assembly for Wales to make provision for the powers of county councils, county borough councils, community councils and other public bodies to make byelaws; the procedure for making byelaws; the enforcement of byelaws; and for connected purposes.
